setting.name: Reset Winsock Catalog
setting.casual_explanation: This resets the Winsock catalog back to its default state to help recover from broken network stack registrations.
setting.why_people_change_it: People use it when they are troubleshooting stubborn connectivity issues that can be caused by damaged Winsock registrations or layered service providers.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: It can help recover a broken network stack, but it is still a repair action rather than a persistent preference, and the change usually expects a restart before the system is fully back to normal.
setting.professional_notes: The live app models this as a command tweak that detects with netsh winsock show catalog and applies with netsh winsock reset. Repo network docs list the same reset action, but tweak provenance and tweak-provenance-missing both still mark the card as category-fallback and review-only pending a stronger tweak-specific upstream repo match.
